findings.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
findings.review_comment: The hardlink fallback mechanism reads arbitrary files using untrusted header.linkname from tar archives without path validation. When hardlink creation fails with EPERM, the code resolves header.linkname against cwd and reads the resulting file, enabling directory traversal attacks. Validate header.linkname to ensure it doesn't contain path traversal sequences before using it in path resolution.
